title: Awesome Agent Observability entry
description: One file in entries/<slug>.yml. Controlled values (category, tags, license, agent_types) are checked against registry/ by scripts/validate.mjs.

url.description: Canonical link: the repository, or the official page when there is no repository.

description.description: One factual sentence, at most 160 characters, ending with a dot.

license.description: An id from registry/licenses.yml, or unknown.

otlp.description: OTLP support: a list of ingest and export, an empty list for none, or unknown.

conventions.description: Semantic conventions followed: a list, an empty list for none, or unknown.

otel_evidence.description: Public page or file that supports the otlp and conventions values.

telemetry.description: How a framework emits telemetry. otel: through the OpenTelemetry API; own: its own trace model, callbacks or exporters; external: only through a separate instrumentation library; none; unknown.

telemetry_docs.description: The documentation page that the telemetry value was read from.

vendor_affiliation.description: Set when the submitter works on the listed project.

historical.description: Reason the entry is kept in the collapsed Archived and historical section.

mature.description: Reason a repository without activity for 12 months is still listed.

body.description: Standards and specs: the body that publishes it.

version.description: Standards and specs: version or status, or unknown.

evidence_url.description: Findings: public evidence (an upstream issue, pull request or public documentation).

versions.description: Findings: the versions the finding was observed with.

status.description: Findings: open, fixed (see fixed_in) or unknown.

last_release.description: Bot-filled by scripts/refresh.mjs; null when the repository has no release.
